### S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-TIGHTER-CAPTURE-001 (story 019) — Tighter-Capture Diagnostic Retest — Integration (manual runtime evidence)

**Story file**: `production/epics/hand-ui/story-019-drag-runtime-retest-tighter-capture.md`
**Test type**: Integration — manual runtime evidence + diagnostic-only. **NOT a code-change story.** No repair commit may land inside this story under any disposition (per `HU-DRAG-RT-19-05`).

**Automated tests**: no new automated tests added by this story. Existing automated tests (`hand_ui_drag_to_board_cell_test`, `hand_ui_drag_to_fan_plate_test`, the PROMPT 696 / 697 / 706 / 709 cohort) MUST remain green at the Sprint 12 retest commit. Verify by running:

```text
cargo test -p client --no-fail-fast
```

with no test in the drag / hand-ui surface regressing vs the Sprint 11 close-out baseline (`origin/main@1617352` — 1129 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored from `production/qa/smoke-sprint-11-2026-05-13.md`).

**What to verify in evidence**:

- Runtime trace captured under the **upgraded** invocation:
  ```text
  RUST_LOG=client::ui::hand=trace,client::presentation::board_rendering=trace,client::card_animations::input_gating=info,lightyear=debug,server::game=debug
  ```
  (upgraded vs story 018: `lightyear=info` → `lightyear=debug`; `server::game=info` → `server::game=debug`; per story 019 §"Reproduction Recipe (tighter capture)").
- **Frame-level video** of the release moment for drag attempts A / B / C / D (30 fps minimum; 60 fps preferred — OBS Studio / ShareX / OS recorder).
- **Synchronised wall-clock timestamps** at millisecond precision on each log producer (server + both clients) — either via `tracing_subscriber::fmt` `.with_timer(...)` or shell wrapper prefixing UTC ISO-8601.
- Raw log capture preserved at `production/qa/evidence/captures/sprint-11-drag-runtime/<dated-subdir>/` (do NOT overwrite story 018 capture dir).
- New evidence file authored at `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-drag-runtime-evidence-tighter.md` (NEW; do NOT overwrite the story 018 evidence file `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-drag-runtime-evidence.md`).
- S1–S5 grey-square attribution truth-table filled with PASS / FAIL / NOT-OBSERVED per row, with evidence pointer (log file + line range OR video timestamp).
- **At least one row per column (A / B / C / D) must be PASS or FAIL** (per `HU-DRAG-RT-19-02`) — i.e., every-row-NOT-OBSERVED is the story 018 outcome and would correctly disposition `cannot-reproduce` (second time) again.
- Disposition recorded as exactly one of `{bug-reproduced, bug-fixed, cannot-reproduce, third-party-limitation}` (per `HU-DRAG-RT-19-03`).
- If `bug-reproduced`: follow-on repair story authored at `production/epics/hand-ui/story-020-<slug>.md` (or `production/epics/playable-client/`) with precise repro; **no repair commit lands inside `S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-TIGHTER-CAPTURE-001`**.
- If `cannot-reproduce` (second time): escalation; evidence file records second time-box exhausted; diagnostic gap surfaced to Sprint 13 candidate authoring; **no third same-scope retest authored without expanded tracing**.
- If `third-party-limitation`: evidence file records platform profile, workaround (if any), no-claim note that this is NOT a Hand UI / Board Rendering / protocol bug, and any `docs/setup/` or `docs/architecture/` documentation update needed.
- If `bug-fixed`: evidence file records cumulative work that resolved the bug (PROMPT 696 / 697 / 706 / 709 cite) and truth-table-PASS rows that prove it; no follow-on required.
- **Primary suspect named (not claimed)**: per story 019 §"Context", S5 (release branch → server) is the hypothesised failing edge based on PROMPT 683-era evidence (8 `C2SActivateCard` sends with zero `stage_or_update` events). The retest does NOT assume S5 is failing — confirm or refute with captured `server::game=debug` trace.
- No production code modified under `client/`, `server/`, `shared/`, `tests/` by this story (`HU-DRAG-RT-19-05`).
- No new client-side optimistic authority for stage / activate / submit (`HU-DRAG-RT-19-06`; ADR-002 + ADR-009 binding).

**Edge cases** (per story 019 §"Friend-game route" — inherited from story 018):

- Drag attempt A: standard unit onto BoardCell → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 PASS chain.
- Drag attempt B: Instant card onto fan plate → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 → S5 PASS chain (fan-plate branch; S3 has no board ghost, so `NOT-OBSERVED` for the BoardCell ghost column is correct).
- Drag attempt C: cancel mid-drag off any valid target → expect S1 → S2 → S3 (ghost cleared) → S4 (cursor-outside) → S5 (no-op cleanup); **no** `C2SActivateCard` send.
- Drag attempt D: invalid drop on opponent lane / out-of-spawn-range cell → expect S1 → S2 → S3 → S4 (invalid target) → S5 (snap-back); **no** `C2SActivateCard` send.

**Time-box**: **1.5 days** per `HU-DRAG-RT-19` AC (longer than story 018's 1.0 day because the tighter capture requires synchronised timestamp wiring + video recording setup). If S1–S5 cannot be filled with ≥1 PASS/FAIL row per column within 1.5 days, lock truth-table as best-effort with `NOT-OBSERVED` rows explicitly named; disposition `cannot-reproduce` (second time); escalate to Sprint 13 candidate authoring; **no third same-scope retest** without expanded tracing.

- **Path A — Restore panic-guard in production**: re-add `assert!(unit_index < N, "unit_index={unit_index}")` (or equivalent) at entry of `co_occupancy_offset` in `client/src/ui/board/<module>.rs` (exact module verified at `/story-readiness`/`/dev-story` time). Re-arm the test as `#[should_panic(expected = "unit_index=2")]` without `#[ignore]`. **Path A requires explicit production-design write-up before code change** (AC2): (a) upstream caller invariant; (b) why guard is defensive-mandatory; (c) why not a hot-path cost concern.
- **Path B — Test rewritten to assert non-panic behaviour**: rewrite `test_cooccupancy_index_two_panics_with_offending_index` → `test_cooccupancy_index_two_returns_expected_offset` (or equivalent canonical name); remove `#[should_panic]`; assert current production return value; remove `#[ignore]`. **Path B requires production rationale before test rewrite** (AC3): (a) where the upstream bounds-check now lives; (b) what `co_occupancy_offset(2, ..)` now returns; (c) why silent overflow is no longer a risk.

**Either path is acceptable IFF the rationale is captured. The `#[should_panic]` invariant may NOT be silently deleted** — this is the hard constraint of Cluster B4 disposition.

**Required automated tests**:

```text
cargo test -p client --no-fail-fast
cargo test --workspace --tests --no-fail-fast
```

**What to verify**:

- Binary decision recorded in story 014 "Binary Design Decision" section before any code change (AC1). `git log --oneline` of story trail shows the decision-recording commit BEFORE the code-change commit.
- Path A write-up OR Path B rationale committed before the code change (AC2 / AC3).
- Test passes under chosen path (AC4): Path A re-armed `test_cooccupancy_index_two_panics_with_offending_index` with `#[should_panic]`; Path B rewritten `test_cooccupancy_index_two_returns_expected_offset` with no `#[should_panic]` and no `#[ignore]`.
- Workspace ignored count drops by 1 vs Sprint 11 close-out baseline of 5 (AC5); no new undocumented `#[ignore]` marker introduced.
- Original PROMPT 750 D-5 owner comment removed only after the test passes (AC6).
- **`#[should_panic]` invariant NOT silently deleted** (AC7): `git log --oneline -- tests/unit/board_rendering/status_icons_test.rs` shows the rationale commit before the test rewrite commit; diff review verifies no other `#[should_panic]` attribute was silently dropped.
- `production/sprint-status.yaml`, `production/sprints/sprint-12.md`, `production/stage.txt` unchanged (AC8).

**Affected ignored test** (B4; `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-ignored-d5-triage.md` row 86):

- `test_cooccupancy_index_two_panics_with_offending_index` at `tests/unit/board_rendering/status_icons_test.rs:167` — `#[ignore = "PROMPT 750 D-5: production co_occupancy_offset no longer panics on index 2 — needs design decision: restore panic guard or update test to assert non-panic behavior"]`.

**Edge cases**:

The 5 ignored tests carried forward from Sprint 11 (`production/qa/smoke-sprint-11-2026-05-13.md` — 1129/0/5; `production/qa/evidence/sprint-11-ignored-d5-triage.md` Cluster B rows 83–87) are each owned by a Sprint 12 Must Have story:

| # | Test | Sprint 12 Must Have story | Disposition shape |
|---|------|---------------------------|-------------------|
| B1 | `br_8e_board_ghost_pointer_messages_leave_ghost_owned_by_hand_ui` (`tests/integration/board_rendering/ghost_preview_bridge_test.rs:147`) | `S11-TD-FIXTURE-D-RESIDUALS-001` (story 015 — umbrella) OR split `S11-TD-FIXTURE-BOARD-GHOST-DRAG-PRODUCER-001` | B1.a expand fixture OR B1.b relocate (test-only) |
| B2 | `test_snapshot_rebuild_clears_stale_visuals_and_spawns_snapshot_units_and_objectives` (`tests/integration/board_rendering/snapshot_spawn_test.rs:39`) | `S11-TD-FIXTURE-HUD-SNAPSHOT-PHASE-BRIDGE-001` (story 012) | Path A expand fixture OR Path B relocate (test-only) |
| B3 | `test_lobby_buttons_drive_create_join_slot_class_and_confirm_commands` (`tests/integration/playable_client/native_operator_controls_test.rs:106`) | `S11-LOBBY-CONFIRM-CLASS-INTENT-CHAIN-001` (story 013) | Production fix in lobby input system (primary) OR test redesign + UX write-up (fallback) |
| B4 | `test_cooccupancy_index_two_panics_with_offending_index` (`tests/unit/board_rendering/status_icons_test.rs:167`) | `S11-TD-COOCCUPANCY-PANIC-GUARD-DECISION-001` (story 014) | Path A restore panic-guard + re-arm test OR Path B rewrite test (rationale commit precedes code change) |
| B5 | `shop_auction_ui_prepooled_panel_roots_are_bevy_ui_nodes` (`tests/unit/shop_auction_ui/plugin_scaffold_formulas_test.rs:25`) | `S11-TD-FIXTURE-D-RESIDUALS-001` (story 015 — umbrella) OR split `S11-TD-SHOP-AUCTION-UI-COUNT-DRIFT-001` | B5.a update formula 57→66 OR B5.b trim spawn 66→57 (rationale before code change) |

**Disposition policy for the 5 retained tests during Sprint 12**:

- This QA plan does **NOT un-`#[ignore]`** any of them. That work happens under each Must Have story's `/dev-story` (separate prompt per story).
- Each Must Have story enforces the silent-deletion guard: the PROMPT 750 D-5 owner comment is removed **only after** the affected test (or its replacement) passes locally. Each story requires a decision-recording commit (rationale) BEFORE the code-change commit per the story's AC ordering.
- The `#[should_panic]` invariant on B4 may NOT be silently deleted under any disposition (story 014 hard constraint).
- The B5 formula-vs-trim decision requires a written rationale before code change (story 015 hard constraint).
- If any Must Have story dispositions a test as **delete-with-rationale**, the rationale lives in the story's evidence file AND the test removal is reviewed against the silent-deletion guard.
- If any Must Have story closes its test, the workspace ignored count drops by 1 (or by 2 for the B1+B5 umbrella story 015).
- If a Must Have story is dispositioned `cannot-reproduce` / blocked / paused, the ignored test remains carried until a separate follow-on story authors a path forward; the test does NOT become an undocumented `#[ignore]` retention.
- **At Sprint 12 close-out**: the workspace ignored count drop is the canonical evidence of D-5 retirement. If all 5 close cleanly, the workspace ignored count drops from 5 to 0. If some close and others remain (e.g., umbrella split, late-pull Should Have), every retained `#[ignore]` carries owner-named disposition pointing at a Sprint 12 or Sprint 13 follow-on story id.

## Manual Runtime Evidence Expectations

This section codifies the manual-evidence bar for the two Sprint 12 rows that require physical / observable verification beyond automated tests.

### Drag-and-Drop Tighter-Capture Runtime (story 019 — `S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-TIGHTER-CAPTURE-001`)

- **Scope**: PLACEMENT-phase drag-and-drop only. Does **not** cover GAME_OVER, lobby flow, draft grid, or shop / auction flows beyond what is incidentally exercised reaching PLACEMENT.
- **Capture mode (TIGHTER than story 018)**: live two-client friend-game session (host + joiner on local network); both clients with the **upgraded** `RUST_LOG` invocation (`lightyear=debug`, `server::game=debug`); **synchronised wall-clock UTC ISO-8601 timestamps at millisecond precision** on each log producer; per-attempt **frame-level video** at 30 fps minimum (60 fps preferred) capturing the release moment for each of drag attempts A / B / C / D; raw `.log` capture preserved per client.
- **Tracing-init wiring**: per-run setup only. Does NOT land as permanent code change inside story 019. If the implementation prompt determines millisecond-UTC timestamps should be the project default, a separate small follow-on story is authored.
- **Truth-table**: every cell across the S1–S5 × {A, B, C, D} grid must be filled with PASS / FAIL / NOT-OBSERVED and an evidence pointer (log file + line range OR video timestamp + frame stamp).
- **At least one row per column (A / B / C / D) must be PASS or FAIL** (per `HU-DRAG-RT-19-02`).
- **Primary suspect call-out**: S5 (release branch → server) per PROMPT 683-era evidence (8 `C2SActivateCard` sends with zero `stage_or_update` events). Do NOT assume S5 is failing without captured evidence — confirm or refute with `server::game=debug` trace. Upper rows (S1 / S2 / S3 / S4) may surface unexpected FAILs.
- **Disposition**: exactly one of `{bug-reproduced, bug-fixed, cannot-reproduce, third-party-limitation}`. If `bug-reproduced`, name the offending S1–S5 stage explicitly with failing trace line range.
- **Time-box**: 1.5 days. If exhausted, lock truth-table as best-effort with `NOT-OBSERVED` rows; disposition `cannot-reproduce` (second time); escalate to Sprint 13 with expanded tracing — **no third same-scope retest**.
- **No-claim**: no broad Standard-tier accessibility (`QA-COND-0005`), no playtest validation (`QA-COND-0006`), no full QA, no `S8-QA-001-W1` closure, no public release readiness, no release-candidate readiness, no full game completion.
- **No production code change in this story**: any repair lands under a separate follow-on story (`HU-DRAG-RT-19-05`).

### HUD Timer Eyeball Visual (Should Have, conditional — `S11-HUD-TIMER-EYEBALL-VISUAL-001`)

- **Scope**: cosmetic-only verification that the timer countdown renders during the three timed phases (`DraftInitial` 45s, `DraftShop` 30s, `Placement` 10–12s). Does **not** assert behavioural / synchronisation correctness beyond visible decrement. W2 carry from Sprint 10 smoke retry-7 (cosmetic verification only).
- **Capture mode**: manual two-client friend-game session reaching each timed phase. At minimum one screenshot per phase capturing the visible countdown at start; ideally screenshots at start + midpoint + end per phase.
- **Disposition**: visual verification PASS / FAIL only. If FAIL, the story stays open and a tighter-capture spec story is authored.
- **No-claim**: cosmetic only; no behaviour change asserted; no `S8-QA-001-W1` closure; no broad HUD-completeness claim; no Standard-tier accessibility completion.
- **Authority preservation**: timer authority remains server-side via `S2CPhaseChanged` (ADR-009). No client-side optimistic phase mutation as a side-effect of any eyeball-time fix.

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or evidence-doc with sign-off).
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories that require new automated tests.
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for the manual-evidence Must Have (story 019 — `S11-DRAG-RUNTIME-RETEST-TIGHTER-CAPTURE-001`) and for the conditional visual story (`S11-HUD-TIMER-EYEBALL-VISUAL-001`) when pulled.
- [ ] For each Cluster B Must Have story (012 / 013 / 014 / 015): the decision (Path A vs Path B / umbrella vs split / per-sub-disposition) is recorded in the story file BEFORE any code change commit, with rationale captured; the silent-deletion guard for `#[should_panic]` (B4) and the rationale-before-code-change guard (B5) are observed.
- [ ] For story 015 umbrella vs split: if split chosen, two follow-on story files authored at `production/epics/playable-client/story-NNN-fixture-board-ghost-drag-producer.md` (B1) + `production/epics/playable-client/story-NNN-shop-auction-ui-count-drift.md` (B5); umbrella story 015 closes as decision-record artefact.
- [ ] `cargo test -p client --no-fail-fast` passes for each affected story's test cluster without `Resource not found` or fixture composition panics; workspace ignored count drops or every retained `#[ignore]` has owner-named disposition.
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` in a separate prompt before QA hand-off).
- [ ] No regressions introduced in DRAFT_INITIAL display, lobby manual playability (`be8b37d`), S9-RS-001/002 result flow, SAU-007/SAU-008, HUD chrome, S10-POLISH-001/002/003, Sprint 11 Must Have artefacts.
